title: Designing an LLM-Based Behavioral Activation Chatbot for Young People with Depression: Insights from an Evaluation with Artificial Users and Clinical Experts
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the clinical fidelity and therapeutic quality of a chatbot for depression using standardized psychological scales (Q-BAS). While it incorporates safety protocols for crisis management, it does not evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical belief systems.
